Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR retains runtime chunks referenced through optional aliased loaders without treating ordinary path arguments as required imports. **Example:** A retained entry calls load?.(`./opaque-A1b2C3.mjs`) using an aliased createRequire loader. - **Before:** Bootstrap can omit the chunk, causing MODULE_NOT_FOUND when the extracted runtime starts. - **After:** Bootstrap retains the chunk and its transitive dependencies. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The focused patch is sound on source review, with useful archive-level regression coverage; supplied behavioral evidence remains harness-based. | | **Proof confidence** | 🦐 gold shrimp **(3/6)** | The collaborator-authored bot PR is outside the ordinary contributor proof gate; its reported Linux/Node regression exercises the real archive builder and extracted fixture launcher, with full-distribution behavior remaining unproven. | | **Patch quality** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** A prepared worker runtime can fail to start because a required loader-referenced chunk was omitted. **Reason:** The source confirms the missing retention path, and the maintainer-authored direction explicitly accepts conservative extra retention without changing configuration or required-import semantics. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** Keep this PR open: it fixes a source-confirmed chunk-retention bug still present on main, and the previous body-disclosure finding is resolved; no actionable patch defects remain. **Priority:** P2 **Reviewed head:** `b0fcfc106f20d6199fe38136e73b01c2fca47bb2` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None. ### Tests - Missing end-to-end proof: The supplied evidence covers a synthetic extracted-runtime regression; it does not demonstrate archive preparation from a full built distribution.
Agent review details ### How this fits together Worker runtime preparation consumes the package inventory and chunk-ownership metadata, selects the required import closure, and emits an archive for worker installation. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Package inventory and ownership] --> B[Runtime chunk selector] C[Bounded JavaScript scanner] --> B B --> D[Required import validation] D --> E[Worker runtime archive] E --> F[Extracted runtime] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Use the existing bounded scanner to rescue resolvable literal-call chunks while preserving exact import validation and nested-dependency analysis. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Source inspection confirms the missed template-literal alias path, and the body reports the new archive regression failing on base with MODULE_NOT_FOUND and passing on head; no target code was run during this review. Is this the best way to solve the issue? This is a small complete fix using the existing scanner and retention owner: required chunks survive pruning, ordinary missing paths remain nonmandatory, and the superseded callback is removed from all callers. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/node-bootstrap-runtime-chunks.ts:74`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/b0fcfc106f20d6199fe38136e73b01c2fca47bb2/src/gateway/worker-environments/node-bootstrap-runtime-chunks.ts#L74), [b0fcfc106f20](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/b0fcfc106f20d6199fe38136e73b01c2fca47bb2)) - **Current-main behavior:** Fetched main still routes loader-bearing root files through collectPackageRootImports, whose literal import recording accepts string literals but misses the reported template-literal alias call. ([`src/gateway/worker-environments/node-bootstrap-runtime-chunks.ts:91`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/2f504abebddca671613ede82dee5a704fd4d9478/src/gateway/worker-environments/node-bootstrap-runtime-chunks.ts#L91), [2f504abebddc](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/2f504abebddca671613ede82dee5a704fd4d9478)) - **Regression boundary:** The added optional-loader case prepares and extracts an archive, executes its fixture launcher, and checks retained transitive chunks; the separate negative case protects ordinary missing path arguments.
